# Step - simple_path

`simple_path` · `simplePath` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps only traversers whose path never repeats an element.

## Forms

```text
simple_path()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).both().both().simple_path().count().next()   // 4
```
